dct_description_sm:
Location and description of City and Community operated outdoor rinks within the City of Kingston, Ontario. Seasonal outdoor ice rinks are staffed or unstaffed as indicated. Unstaffed rinks may be under a Community / Neighbourhood Agreement and maintained by volunteers. Existence of the rinks is weather dependent.

For further information see the City's Outdoor Rinks web page.
